plan.notes: Northeastern State University official 2024-25 NSU Undergraduate Catalog requirements for Psychology, B.S. No official semester-by-semester sequence is published, so this is a requirements-only plan. 120 total hours: general education 46 + psychology major 43 (25-hour core including the 6-hour 'select' set + 18 hours of 3000/4000-level psychology electives) + required minor 18 + open electives 13. Minimum grade of C is required in each core course. PSYC 1113 Introduction to Psychology fulfills both a Social & Behavioral Sciences general-education requirement and a major core requirement. Psychology majors must select a minor of 18 hours in a discipline other than psychology or a second major.
